About this testing program
Help us validate CreditorX across every US carrier

CreditorX relies on USSD commands to enable conditional call forwarding — redirecting calls from specific numbers (typically debt collectors) to a call center, while letting your regular calls come through normally. Because every US carrier implements USSD and call forwarding a little differently, real-world behavior can vary significantly from one network to another.

The purpose of this checklist is to gather firsthand testing perspectives from users across every major US carrier. By documenting what works, what doesn't, and any quirks you encounter, you help us confirm that CreditorX behaves reliably for every customer, regardless of which carrier they use.

To get started, select your carrier from the sidebar, enter your name below, and work through each test item in order. Check off the steps that perform as expected, and use the notes field to capture anything unusual. When you're done, submit your results. Thank you for your time and attention to detail.

Each test item includes a short instruction explaining exactly what to do and what to look for. For some items, you'll also find a ▶ View screenshot link just below the instruction — tap it to expand a reference image showing what the expected result looks like on screen.

Your progress is saved automatically as you go — you'll see a brief Saved confirmation in the top right after each action. If you need to stop and come back later, simply close the page. Next time you open it, enter the same name and select the same carrier — your answers will be restored automatically and a yellow banner will confirm that a previous draft was loaded. Once you're satisfied with your answers, click Submit to Google Sheets to finalize. Submitted results are marked as complete and will not be overwritten.
